notes.note: Fix round 6 of the delivery-state change: a remote-change pass starts only when a row the previous projection showed held back by an earlier row of its chat becomes sendable here (no longer on every notice, which re-sent a busy chat's message until it failed); that pass only sends (no reconcile, no syncHeld); a durable replay into a running turn returns deferred instead of not-invoked, so it spends no attempt (useActiveChatSessionMessaging.ts); a renderer whose lock request fails is recorded in a bounded localStorage list and read as unknown liveness, never gone (outboundQueueLease.ts); claimNext marks its claim in flight before announcing it. station-docs-content.ts was regenerated with npm run docs:mcp:generate after the module-map and offline-outbound-queue edits; this reference's description of the shipped topics and their digest check is unchanged. No prose change.
